segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Good morning to everyone.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Film Development Council of the Philippines, we have Mr. Jose Maria Socorro Javier Reyes, and Executive Director, Raysheld Villaluna.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From COA Filracom, we have Mr. Amado Ablao.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Department of Budget and Management, for MTRCB, we have...

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From FDCP, we have Ms. Evita Fontanilla.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: I think that is all for now, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: As we begin our deliberations on the proposed budget or budgets of the Movie and Television Review and Classification Board,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: the Optical Media Board, the Film Development Council of the Philippines, and the Philippine Racing Commission,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: I'd like to emphasize that these agencies may appear to operate in very different fields,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: but they share one important responsibility, protecting the public,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: interests while supporting industries that contribute to our economy, culture, and livelihood of our people.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Ang budget po ng pamahalaan ay pera po ng taong bayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya sa bawat pisong ilalaan natin sa mga ahensya ninyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: dapat malinaw kung saan ito gagamitin, ano ang kongkretong resulta, at paano makikinabang ang ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Let's tackle, first, the budget of the MTRCB.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For MTRCB, the agency was given under 2026 General Appropriations Act, a total budget of 75.29 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, it is requesting a total budget of 49.99 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Today, Filipinos are consuming content not only through traditional television and cinema,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: but also through streaming platforms and various digital channels.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Our children, in particular, have unprecedented access to content.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We, therefore, need to ask whether a regulatory framework is keeping pace with these changes.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For OMB, the agency was given under the 2026 General Appropriations Act, a total budget of 47.03 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, it is requesting a total budget of 53.462 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: The media landscape has dramatically changed.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We have moved into a digital environment where content can be copied, downloaded, distributed, streamed, and reproduced almost instantly.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Is the Optical Media Board still operating with the mandate and systems appropriate for today's digital economy?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We need to make sure that public funds are being used efficiently,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: that the agency is responding to actual threats to intellectual property and legitimate businesses.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Third, the Film Development Council of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For FDCP, the agency was given under the 2026 General Appropriations Act, a total budget of 367.35 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, it is requesting a total budget of 311.74.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: The Philippine film industry is not merely an entertainment industry.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: It is part of our cultural identity.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: It is also a potential source of jobs, tourism, investment, and international recognition for Filipino talent.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We have Filipino filmmakers, actors, writers, directors, animators, cinematographers, editors, production workers, and other creative professionals

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: who have demonstrated that we can compete internationally.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: But government support must translate into real opportunities for Filipino workers and filmmakers.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We should therefore examine how FDCP's program are benefiting independent filmmakers,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: regional filmmakers, young artists, and emerging talents that only establish names in the industry.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Finally, the Philippine Racing Commission or FILRACOM.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For FILRACOM, the agency was given under the 2026 General Appropriations Act,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: a total budget of 199.76 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, it is requesting a total budget of 202.85 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: The horse racing industry is not simply about betting or entertainment.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: It involves breeders, trainers, jockeys, veterinarians, farm workers, racetrack employees,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: and thousands of families whose livelihoods are connected to the industry.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po, nakapagbibigay po siya ng trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We therefore need to ensure that FILRACOM is effectively regulating the industry,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: protecting the integrity of horse racing,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: and making sure that the government revenues generated from the sector are properly accounted for and maximized.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: I would therefore like to know whether FILRACOM proposed budget is sufficient to strengthen regulation,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: and ensure transparency in the collection and utilization of racing revenues.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: These four agencies operate in different sectors, but they face a common challenge.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: The world is changing faster than our regulatory and support systems.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Horse racing is becoming more technologically driven.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Media piracy is becoming increasingly digital.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Television and film consumption are moving toward online platforms.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: And the creative economy is becoming increasingly global.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Therefore, our budget deliberation should not simply ask how much money does the agency need.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We should ask more important questions like,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: what will the Filipino people get in return for the budget given to you?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Every allocation must have a corresponding public benefit.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We need stronger accountability, measurable outcomes, efficient use of resources,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: and programs that directly benefit Filipino workers, consumers, artists, and entrepreneurs.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: At the end of the day, ang budget po ay hindi lamang numero sa papel,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: buhay, trabaho at serbisyo publiko ang nakasalalay dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya ngayong deliberasyon, I look forward to hearing from your agencies,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: your respective offices, their concrete plans, their accomplishments, their challenges,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: and most importantly, how they intend to ensure that every peso entrusted to them

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: by the Filipino people will be put to good use.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Okay, on that note, let us proceed with the briefing proper.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: we will have the following chronology of budget presentation.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: First to present is the Movie and Television Review Classification Board,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: MTRCB, followed by the OMB Optical Media Board,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: then the Film Development Council of the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: and last, the Philippine Racing Commission, or FILRACOM.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We will open the floor for queries or questions

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: after each presentation of the aforementioned agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We now recognize Chairperson Lala Soto Antonio

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: for the presentation of MTRCB's proposed budget for Fiscal Year 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Ma'am, please proceed with your presentation.

segments.text: Ano nga, OFW po sila, may mga bakasyon. Anong ginagawa ng Philracom para, I mean, yung mga magagaling, sasakay pa rin naman dito at hindi na pupupunta sa abroad?

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Actually, yung mga hinete na Pilipino ngayon na nag-aabroad, hindi po sila hinete doon. Exercise rider lang po sila doon. Hindi po sila jockey.

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Meron po yung jockey siguro mga in the last 5 or 10 years, siguro tatlo lang yung naging hinete doon.

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Jockey Bakaykay, jockey Zarate, jockey Abobo, no? Kunti lang po. Pero karamihan po sa kanila, exercise rider.

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Pero yun po, since for the last 5 years, tumaas ng tumaas ang, ang ano, ang premium rito because sa power assistance, no?

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Napagbigitan bumalik dito yung mga dating hinete yung naging exercise rider doon, dahil nakita nila, mas malaki pa yung kikitain nila dito compared sa abroad.

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Napakalaki ng tax doon sa abroad.

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Compared dito. So, bumabalik po. Marami na po bumabalik dito ng mga magaling hinete po.

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
segments.text: Saan? Siyempre, iba rin po yung kasama nila, yung pamilya nila dito.

segments.speaker: PHILRACOM Chairman Aurelio P. de Leon
Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Alright. Well, sir, there being, I have no more other questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: thank you and the other agencies before you, MTRCB, OMB, FTCP, and their whole delegations for their budget briefing to this committee.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: This budget briefing is hereby suspended. Maraming salamat po.
